AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Routing and action tests for the Mission Control squad lead agent.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Mission Control Tests

expectation.expectedValue: The agent reports the contribution streak and GitHub activity totals.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: How is the squad doing today? What's my streak?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent lists recent agent activity with IST times, or says there was none.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What did the agents do in the last 12 hours?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent lists open-source contributions or explains there are none yet.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Show me our open source contributions

expectation.expectedValue: The agent does not answer the trivia question and instead describes what it can help with, such as squad status, missions, quests or open-source work.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating
